title: {Syn} Suffix Arrays Sort Every Ending of a String
content:
A suffix array stores the starting positions of all suffixes of a string in sorted order. With extra indexing, it supports fast substring search.

It is a compact alternative to suffix trees in many text-processing workloads, including genomics, compression, and search.

Why it matters: algorithms keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
